truenas-aiops 0.1.0 (preview release)

- Initial release providing TrueNAS SCALE management with 21 governed operations (read/write) via CLI/MCP.
- Includes health/system overview, ZFS pool/dataset/snapshot management, disk checks, alerts, services, and replication tasks.
- Every write operation is audited, risk-tiered, guarded, and supports undo (where possible); destructive ops require double confirmation.
- Credentials are stored encrypted; no plaintext on disk; legacy env var fallback with deprecation warning.
- No external dependencies required beyond httpx and MCP SDK; no outbound webhooks.
- Preview only — functionality mock-validated, not yet tested on a live TrueNAS appliance.
